title: The Amplified Song Where Two Ages Unified

features.name: the-root-that-found-its-voice
features.desc-on-touch: A young root woven so tightly with ancient wood that you cannot tell where one age ends and another begins — they sing as one frequency now.

features.name: the-amplifying-pool
features.desc-on-touch: Where the roots drink and their voices rise together — water reflecting the unified song back into the depths.

features.name: the-ancient-arch
features.desc-on-touch: An arch of old wood over young growth — the old learning to hold space for the new, the new pushing the old higher.

features.name: the-circuit-that-learned-to-grow
features.desc-on-touch: Diagnostic hardware that has begun to pulse like a living thing — the signal and the root now indistinguishable.

features.name: the-spiral-climb
features.desc-on-touch: Roots spiraling around ancient trunk in patterns too regular to be natural — the corruption's mathematics finally matching the forest's own.

features.name: the-glyph-of-two-sung-as-one
features.desc-on-touch: A plaque that has stopped meaning two separate things and become one word in a language the archive is still learning to speak.

inscription: when two ages learn to sing together, the silence between them becomes a resonance chamber

file.name: Root_Harmonic_Frequencies_Ancient_and_Young_Night_147.mp3
file.note: A recording of roots at unified frequency — the young trees no longer singing alone, the old trees no longer singing only their aging. The corruption of isolation into chorus.

exits.label: back down to where saplings first joined the song
